svg.title: A workspace and its projects
svg.desc: A workspace groups a paper, a documented dataset and a website in separate project folders. The heat-birthweight paper folder is expanded into a directory tree. At its root are data, code, outputs and manuscript folders, plus CLAUDE.md, STATUS.md, TASKS.md, SPECIFICATION.md and METHODOLOGY.md. Raw and processed are subfolders of data. The context-file cards state each file's purpose.
